title: One-equation reductions for the rational Hamilton quaternions and Lipschitz order
exact_target: Let $\mathbb H_{\mathbb Q}$ be the Hamilton quaternion algebra over $\mathbb Q$, and let $\mathcal O=\mathbb Z+i\mathbb Z+j\mathbb Z+k\mathbb Z$ be its Lipschitz order. Decide the solvability of arbitrary noncommutative polynomial equations with either rational or quaternion coefficients, and with unknowns constrained either to $\mathbb H_{\mathbb Q}$ or to $\mathcal O$. Also ask for existential definitions of $\mathbb Z$ in $\mathcal O$ and of $\mathbb Q$ in $\mathbb H_{\mathbb Q}$, and for the analogous decision questions in $M_n(\mathbb Z)$ and $M_n(\mathbb Q)$.
